test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘SING’ is written as ‘22121710’ and ‘FOUR’ is written as ‘9182421’. How will ‘BEAN’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

Logic: Place value of letter + 3 = Code of that letter.

‘SING’ is written as ‘22121710’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ad352466f67ded3d51241fd0eb0665212b203520101a3b22da2b1aa7d497ef5.png] 

‘FOUR’ is written as ‘9182421’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fffe7fe09b9eb889b320bc3a55b0adcf3a52821e7bf4bcde47b2b0898584136c.png] 

Similarly, for ‘**BEAN’**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a806b0713345918f73da107c63bdd4633c9dd26de4ce93026b87aa1eb929b9bc.png] 

So, '‘**BEAN**’' will be coded as '58417'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
